ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the vertices of $\triangle ABC$ are at the vertices of a square grid. What is the value of $\sin A$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Draw line segment DC, \\
from the grid we know that $CD\perp AB$, \\
thus $DC = \sqrt{2}$, $AC = \sqrt{10}$, \\
hence $\sin A = \frac{DC}{AC} = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{10}} = \boxed{\frac{\sqrt{5}}{5}}$.
